title: The Planetary Adventure
intro: This quiz follows Max's journey through the solar system and the special features he discovers on each planet.

questions.prompt: Why did Max call Mercury the fastest planet?
choices: It spins faster than every other planet
It travels around the Sun faster than the other planets
It has the strongest winds
It has the fastest storms
questions.explanation: Mercury travels around the Sun faster than the other planets.

choices: It is covered by thick clouds that trap heat
It is made entirely of fire
It has many active volcanoes
It is the largest planet
questions.explanation: Venus is extremely hot because thick clouds trap heat.

questions.prompt: What did Max notice about Earth?
choices: It was dusty, dry, and red
It had only ice and rocks
It had oceans, clouds, land, air, and life
It was surrounded by enormous rings
questions.explanation: Earth had oceans, clouds, land, air, and life.

questions.prompt: Which planet is the largest and has a giant storm bigger than Earth?
choices: Mars
Jupiter
Saturn
Neptune
questions.explanation: Jupiter is the largest planet and has a giant storm bigger than Earth.

questions.prompt: Which statement correctly describes Uranus and Neptune?
choices: Uranus spins on its side, and Neptune has very strong winds
Uranus is red, and Neptune has large rings
Uranus is the hottest planet, and Neptune is closest to the Sun
Uranus has life, and Neptune is covered with forests
questions.explanation: Uranus spins on its side, and Neptune has very strong winds.
